sourceState: AI Providers is distilled to four minimal entries—Providers, Keys, Routing, and Local—while preserving the existing local provider catalog, credential storage, provider test, routing, health, and service-port APIs. Explanatory cards and nonessential Usage/About surfaces were removed; the Settings overview, return control, shared scene, and other application surfaces remain unchanged.
